transcription.text: This is a story about a boy.
The boy wants to have some fun.
Wolf, wolf, I see a wolf.
Wolf, wolf, I see a wolf.
Wolf, wolf, I see a wolf.
Wolf, wolf, I see a wolf.
Wolf, wolf, I see a wolf.
Wolf, wolf, I see a wolf.
Oh no, my sheep, my sheep.
The boy goes to the farm.
I see a wolf, but no one comes.
